patterns: APPSC asks single-fact classification items: which sector includes water supply / trade / fisheries (secondary, tertiary, primary), often as a match with GDP-CSO.
Recurring data facts: services share 54.4% in 2017-18 (G2), agriculture largest at Independence, post-1991 growth service-led.
Decreasing-order-of-contribution items (Services > Industry > Agriculture) are a common shape in other PSCs.
App adds many current 2025-26 figures, models (Lewis, Clark-Fisher) and AP GSVA splits; more statement-style and data-heavy than the PYQs.
Trap: mining is primary in the three-sector scheme but under Industry in GVA / AP Survey tables.
